title: File:MtFuji ChildrensWorld.jpg
claims: The image shows the main entrance area of Mount Fuji Children's World, with carp streamers above grass, an entrance sign reading Mt.FUJI CHILDREN'S WORLD, and Mount Fuji behind the sign.

The Commons file identifies Mount Fuji Children's World, the exact start venue of FUJI100mi; it contains no race bib, start arch, corral, timing mat or race-day crowd, so it is a venue photograph, not race-day evidence.
The author is Mocchy; the file is public domain; the original is 2,048 x 1,152 pixels and 551,757 bytes; the photograph was taken from the main gate on 2015-05-02 and uploaded on 2015-05-25.
The route page uses a 960 x 540 copy of 170,926 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits the author, public-domain status and source.
